Introduction
This document out lines the details equipment Inspection I2, which to be 
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the title block.
The first draft 
initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, 
reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa and revised by 
EDEC quality control 
eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd El Salam, approved by eng. Michael Goerge: 
Head Sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320MW, and certified by eng. 
Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. inspection and quality control 
head sector.
